SELECT 
	machinename=SL.machinename,
	SubReport = 1,
	allsale = IsNull( sum(round(((SD.looseqty + SD.packqty * SD.packunits) * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - (.01 *  SD.discperc)),2))  ,0),
	saleqty=  IsNull( sum(SD.looseqty + SD.BonusQty + (SD.packqty * SD.packunits)), 0),
	cashsalecount=  
		IsNull(
		(SELECT COUNT(SLL.SaleInvCode) 
		FROM saleledger sll 
		where sll.machinename=SL.machinename and
			sll.salecatcode in (3) and
			sll.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate), 0),
	category=IC.name,
	
	totaldisc= ( select sum(flatdisc) 
					 from saleledger
					 where saleledger.machinename=SL.machinename and
							 saleledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate),
	misccharg= ( select sum(misccharges) 
					 from saleledger
					 where saleledger.machinename=SL.machinename and
							 saleledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate),
	totalinvdiscperc= (select sum(ISNULL(B.invdiscperc,0))
							 from
									(select   invdiscperc = IsNull( sum(Round(((saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.packqty * saledetail.packunits) * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)),2)) * 0.01 * saleledger.discperc, 0)
	
									 from     saleledger, saledetail  
									 where    saleledger.machinename=SL.machinename and
												 (saleledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate) AND
												 saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode 
												 
	
									  group by saleledger.saleinvcode,
												  saleledger.discperc
		 
									) as  B),

	diff=(select sum ( ISNULL(A.rounddifference,0)) 
			from
	
				(SELECT 
							rounddifference= Round(Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.saleprice)
													- Round(Sum (Round(( dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)) + (dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc),2)), 2)
													- Sum ( Round(dbo.saledetail.looseqty   * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice  - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100) 
													+ dbo.saleledger.misccharges - saleledger.flatdisc,0)  
	
							-
	
						  (Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.saleprice)
													- Round(Sum (Round(( dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)) + (dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc),2)), 2)
													- Sum (Round( dbo.saledetail.looseqty   * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice  - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100)
													+ dbo.saleledger.misccharges - saleledger.flatdisc)
							,
						 netammount= (Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.saleprice)
										 - Round(Sum (Round(( dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)) + (dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc),2)), 2) + Round(Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty   * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice  - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01))) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100), 2) + dbo.saleledger.flatdisc + dbo.saleledger.misccharges )
	
					FROM     dbo.saleledger, 
								dbo.saledetail
	
					WHERE ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) and 
							( dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (3,1) ) and  
	
							(saleledger.machinename=SL.machinename )and
							 (saleledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate)          
	
					GROUP BY dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
								dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
								dbo.saleledger.date,   
								dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
								dbo.saleledger.discperc,  
								dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
								dbo.saleledger.salecatcode
					) as A
	
	
		),

	srtotal=(select  ISNULL(sum(isnull(c.invsalereturn,0)),0)
				from (select
								invsalereturn= IsNull( Round(sum(Round(((srdetail.looseqty + srdetail.packqty * srdetail.packunits) * srdetail.srprice) * (1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc)),2)) * (1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) + srledger.misccharges - srledger.flatdisc,0),0)
													 + /* Add Item level salestax*/
														Round( Round(	Sum (Round (dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.unitsalestax + Round ( Round ( dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (1 - dbo.srdetail.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * dbo.srdetail.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )
													 + /* Add Invoice lever salestax*/
														Round ( (Sum ( dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice) 
													 -    Round(Sum (Round( dbo.srdetail.looseqty  * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01),2)), 2)     
													 -  Round(Sum (Round( (dbo.srdetail.looseqty  ) * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (1 - (dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.srledger.discperc /100), 2)
													 - srledger.flatdisc ) * srledger.invgstperc1 * 0.01 , 2)
															,0)/* end of sales tax round*/	
														,0)/* end of main null function*/										 
						from     srledger, srdetail  
						where    srledger.srinvcode = srdetail.srinvcode and
									srledger.srcatcode IN(6,8)     and 
									srledger.machinename=SL.machinename and
									srledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate
		 
	
						group by srledger.srinvcode,
									 srledger.srcatcode,
									srledger.date,
									srledger.discperc,
									srledger.misccharges,
									srledger.flatdisc,
									srledger.invgstperc1
	
						) as C
	
			),

	creditsale=  (select ISNULL(sum (isNull(d.creditsale,0)),0)
	
					  from   (select   creditsale = IsNull( Round(sum(Round(((saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.packqty * saledetail.packunits) * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)),2)) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + saleledger.misccharges + saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc,0)
																		+ /*add invoice level salestax*/
																		Round(Round ( (Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.saleprice) 
																		-   Round(Sum (Round(( dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)) + (dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc),2)), 2) 
																		-  Sum (Round( dbo.saledetail.looseqty   * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice  - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100)
																		- saleledger.flatdisc ) * saleledger.invgstperc1 * 0.01 , 2)
																		+ /*add Item level salestax*/
																		Sum (Round (dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (dbo.saledetail.looseqty * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - dbo.saledetail.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * dbo.saledetail.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )
																		,0) /* end of sum of tax round*/
																		,0)/* end of main null round*/
		 
								 from     saleledger, saledetail  
								 where 	 saleledger.machinename=SL.machinename and
											 saleledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate AND
											 saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode and
											 saleledger.salecatcode IN ( 2 )  
		 
		  
		 
								group by saleledger.saleinvcode,
											salecatcode, 
											saleledger.date,
											saleledger.discperc,
											saleledger.misccharges,
											saleledger.salestax,
											saleledger.flatdisc,
											saleledger.invgstperc1
								)as D
					),

	totaltax=(SELECT ISNULL( SUM(Round(INV.itemsalestax + invtax,0) ),0)
				FROM
						(Select itemsalestax = Sum (Round (dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (dbo.saledetail.looseqty * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - dbo.saledetail.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * dbo.saledetail.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ),
									 
						invtax=	Round ( (Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.saleprice) 
												 -   Round(Sum (Round(( dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)) + (dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc),2)), 2) 
												 -  Sum (Round( dbo.saledetail.looseqty   * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice  - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100)
												 - saleledger.flatdisc ) * saleledger.invgstperc1 * 0.01 , 2)
			 
						from saleledger,saledetail
						WHERE ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) and 
								( dbo.saleledger.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate) AND
								( dbo.saleledger.machinename= SL.machinename )
	
						GROUP BY dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
									dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
									dbo.saleledger.date,   
									dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
									dbo.saleledger.discperc,  
									dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
									dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1 										
							 ) as INV),
	custname=SPACE(100),
	InvCount = 0.00,
	SaleAmt = 0.00,
	ReturnAmt = 0.00
FROM saledetail SD,
     saleledger SL,
     item I, 
     itemcategory IC
WHERE 
	SL.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate and
	SL.saleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode and
	SD.icode=I.icode AND
	I.icatcode=IC.icatcode 
GROUP BY 
	SL.machinename,
	I.icatcode,
	IC.name
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	machinename=T.machinename,
	SubReport = 2,
	AllSale = 0.00,
	SaleQty= 0.00,
	cashsalecount= 0.00,
	category=SPACE(100),
	totaldisc= 0.00,
	misccharg= 0.00,
	totalinvdiscperc= 0.00,
	diff= 0.00,
	srtotal= 0.00,
	creditsale= 0.00,
	totaltax= 0.00,
	custname=T.custname,
	InvCount = COUNT(T.invcode),
	SaleAmt = SUM(T.SaleAmt),
	ReturnAmt = SUM(T.ReturnAmt)
FROM
	(SELECT 
		machinename=dbo.saleledger.machinename,
		invcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,    
		custname=dbo.accounts.name, 
		SaleAmt = dbo.fn_GetSaleInvTotal(dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode),
		ReturnAmt=0.00
	FROM dbo.saleledger, 
			dbo.accounts
	WHERE ( dbo.saleledger.Date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate)and
			( dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (2)) and
			( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )
	GROUP BY 
			dbo.saleledger.machinename,
			dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
			dbo.accounts.name 
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		machinename=dbo.saleledger.machinename,
		invcode     = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,    
		custname=dbo.accounts.name, 
		SaleAmt = dbo.fn_GetSaleInvTotal(dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode),
		ReturnAmt=0.00
	FROM dbo.saleledger, dbo.accounts
	WHERE ( DBO.SaleLedger.impactinventory = 'N') AND 
			( dbo.saleledger.Date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate) and
			( dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (2)) and
			( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )
	GROUP BY 
			dbo.saleledger.machinename,
			dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
			dbo.accounts.name
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		machinename=dbo.srledger.machinename,
		invcode     = dbo.srledger.srinvcode, 
		custname=dbo.accounts.name,
		SaleAmt = 0.00,
		ReturnAmt=dbo.fn_GetSRInvTotal(dbo.srledger.srinvcode)
	 FROM dbo.srledger, 
			dbo.accounts
	WHERE 
			( dbo.srledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )and 
			( dbo.srledger.srcatcode=7)and 
			( dbo.srledger.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate)            
	GROUP BY 
		dbo.srledger.machinename,
		dbo.srledger.srinvcode,   
		dbo.accounts.name) T
GROUP BY
	T.machinename, T.custname
ORDER BY 
	machinename, subreport, category, custname

objects.name: t_3
objects.text: if( subreport =1,'Category Sale Summary', 'Credit Sale Summary')

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: sum( allsale for group 1) -  totaldisc  -  totalinvdiscperc  +  misccharg + totaltax  +  diff  -  srtotal   -  creditsale
